query: I'm evaluating a 64‑year‑old female inpatient with DVT and high comorbidity burden. Among females 59–69 with DVT above the 75th comorbidity percentile, report cohort size, 30‑day mortality, major complication rate, median survival for decedents, and composite risk score quartiles.
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dvt IS NOT NULL AND p.age BETWEEN 59 AND 69 THEN a.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id), 0) AS cohort_size, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL AND a.deathtime <= a.dischtime + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN a.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_30d, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.icd_code = 'Major complication' THEN a.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id), 0) AS major_complication_rate, CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN a.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN (a.deathtime - a.dischtime) END) AS FLOAT) AS average_survival_days, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.score > 0.75 THEN a.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id), 0) AS score_quartile_75 FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN (SELECT subject_id, score FROM risk_scores) s ON a.subject_id = s.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.age = 64 AND p.dvt IS NOT NULL;
